CrawlEngine with defaults batch scrapes like the free function

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(nil)
urls = ['https://example.com/page1', 'https://example.com/page2']
result = Crawlberg.batch_scrape(engine, urls)
puts result.inspect
```
